title: security.zakerne.com dashboard lacks security headers present on main application (no CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy)
description: The subdomain security.zakerne.com (self-described via its HTML meta description as the 'Zakerne security monitoring dashboard', a client-side rendered SPA) does not send the same security header baseline as the main zakerne.com/www.zakerne.com application. The main app sends Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security (with preload), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Permissions-Policy. security.zakerne.com sends only Cloudflare/NEL headers and cache-control, omitting all of the above. Note: this subdomain is covered by the same Cloudflare TLS certificate (SAN includes security.zakerne.com and *.security.zakerne.com), so it is in-scope application-layer infrastructure, not third-party.
reproduction_steps: Compare header set against curl -s -I https://zakerne.com
Observe absence of content-security-policy, strict-transport-security, x-frame-options, x-content-type-options, permissions-policy on the security.zakerne.com response
impact: A dashboard described as a security-monitoring tool lacking clickjacking (X-Frame-Options), MIME-sniffing (X-Content-Type-Options), and CSP protections is a weaker target for framing/UI-redress or injected-script attacks than the rest of the estate, which is inconsistent given its likely sensitivity (security monitoring data). No content or authentication bypass was tested or observed.
remediation: Apply the same security header baseline (CSP, HSTS with preload, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Permissions-Policy) used on the main zakerne.com application to security.zakerne.com and any other first-party subdomains.
